learning_outcomes.text: Students are familiar with the basics of probability theory and statistics.
They acquire skills in modeling random experiments and evaluating statistical data.
They can successfully apply probability theory and statistical methods to technical problems.
They can simulate stochastic processes using Monte Carlo methods.

syllabus_topics: Probability theory: concept of probability, urn experiments, discrete probability distributions, conditional probabilities, central limit theorem, Bayes' theorem
Random variables: probability distribution functions and probability density functions, expected value, (co)variances and standard deviation, correlation coefficients
Mathematical statistics (confidence intervals, hypothesis testing, Chi-square test)
Reliability theory (failure rate, Weibull distribution, system reliability)
assessment_rules: To receive credit points, the module exam must be passed. The grade's weight for the final grade is determined by ECTS credit points.
